verification_report.summary: The proof is correct in the exact product scope stated. Sequential checking found that the Stone quotient construction, upper-semicontinuity descent, extended-real convexity arguments, fixed-neighborhood regularizations, smoothing, and summable tail corrections are valid. The polyhedral argument correctly handles lower-dimensional, unbounded, cornered, and zero-dimensional chambers by working in Aff(P) and on compact polytope cores. The chart extension remains subordinate to the explicit generator-preserving hypothesis. Mandatory reference searching was followed by direct comparison with the pinned official CLD arXiv v2 source, whose definitions and hypotheses match every cited use. No critical error or unresolved gap was found.
